panels.title: Target Services Online/Offline Status
panels.description: 0 = Prometheus could not scrape the target. Django Dev is expected to be offline whenever the prod compose profile is running. A tile showing a raw job name is a scrape target with no friendly name yet.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: All Django jobs combined, counted before any middleware runs.

panels.title: Error Rate (5xx)
panels.description: clamp_min keeps the ratio defined when there is no traffic.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by Service
panels.description: WSGI counts all four gunicorn workers through the multiprocess registry; ASGI is a single daphne process.

panels.title: Requests by Transport
panels.description: http vs websocket. Websocket traffic only appears on the ASGI job.

panels.title: Unhandled Exceptions by Type
panels.description: Exceptions that escaped the view. A non-zero line here is always worth investigating.

panels.title: Top 15 Error Responses by View
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx broken down by the view that produced them.

panels.title: Middleware Overhead
panels.description: The gap between these two lines is time spent in the middleware chain rather than in your view.

panels.title: Requests with Unknown Latency
panels.description: Requests the middleware could not time, usually because an earlier middleware short-circuited the chain.

panels.title: Query Execution Rate
panels.description: Statements issued through Django's instrumented postgresql backend.

panels.title: New DB Connections
panels.description: High and steady means connections are not being reused; check CONN_MAX_AGE against PgBouncer's transaction pooling.

panels.title: Connection Utilization
panels.description: Server-side backends against max_connections.

panels.title: Server Backends (behind PgBouncer)
panels.description: Django connects through PgBouncer in transaction mode, so this tracks the pool (DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE=20), not client connections.

panels.title: Shared Buffer Hit Ratio
panels.description: Sustained below ~95% usually means shared_buffers is too small for the working set.

panels.title: Tuple Operations
panels.description: returned >> fetched is the signature of sequential scans.

panels.title: Temp File Usage
panels.description: Queries spilling to disk because work_mem was not enough.

panels.title: Memory Utilization
panels.description: Against the 256mb maxmemory set in docker-compose/cache.yml. At the cap the volatile-lru policy starts evicting.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Blocked clients are waiting on BLPOP and similar -- expected with Celery, which long-polls its broker list.

panels.title: Keys per Database
panels.description: db2 is the Celery broker, so its key count is queue backlog.

panels.title: Evictions & Expirations
panels.description: Sustained eviction means the 256mb cap is too small for the working set -- cache entries are being thrown away early.

panels.title: CPU Usage by Container
panels.description: Percent of a single core. 100% means one core fully saturated.

panels.title: Memory Working Set by Container
panels.description: Working set, not RSS -- this is the number the OOM killer uses.

panels.title: Container Restarts (1h)
panels.description: A step means the container was recreated or restarted within the last hour. Steady zero is what you want.

panels.title: Root Disk Used
panels.description: --path.rootfs strips the /host/root bind mount prefix, so the host root filesystem reports as /.

panels.title: CPU by Mode
panels.description: iowait climbing while user stays flat points at disk, not CPU.

panels.title: Host Network
panels.description: Physical interfaces only; veth and bridge devices double-count container traffic.

panels.title: Log Volume by Service
panels.description: Lines per minute. A sudden step usually precedes an incident.

panels.title: Error Log Rate by Service
panels.description: Case-insensitive match on error/exception/traceback/critical/fatal across the app containers.

panels.title: Recent Errors (all app containers)
panels.description: Live tail. Click a line to expand its labels and jump to that container's full stream.
